newsitem.title: USA: Manor Care sets Q1 dividend of $0.22/shr.
newsitem.headline: Manor Care sets Q1 dividend of $0.22/shr.

text.p: Manor Care Inc said Wednesday its board declared a first quarter cash dividend of $0.22 per share, payable August 27 to shareholders of record on August 15. 1997.
The company operates 208 health care faciities in 29 states and also owns 51 percent of Vitalink Pharmacy Services. It also holds a controlling interest in In Home Health Inc .

The company and its Vitalink subsidiary are presently involved in a lawsuit against GranCare Inc to enforce a noncompetition agreement with GranCare, which is in an acquisition proposal with Living Centers of America.
